Marketing Manager

Location Mirik, Darjeeling
Experience 0–3 Years
Team Growth & Communications

Build Brands People Remember

Marketing today is more than posting content and running ads. It's about creating meaningful connections between brands and people.

We're looking for a Marketing Manager who can blend creativity with strategy. Someone who understands how brands grow, how audiences engage, and how campaigns create measurable impact.

You'll help shape the visibility and growth of Studio 1947 while also contributing to client projects across technology, design, social impact, education, research, and innovation.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and execute marketing strategies across digital channels.
  • Plan and manage campaigns from concept to execution.
  • Drive lead generation and brand awareness initiatives.
  • Collaborate with designers, writers, and content creators.
  • Manage social media growth and audience engagement.
  • Track campaign performance and optimize based on insights.
  • Identify growth opportunities, partnerships, and collaborations.
  • Support business development through marketing initiatives.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong understanding of digital marketing and brand strategy.
  • Experience managing campaigns across multiple channels.
  • Ability to balance creativity with performance-driven thinking.
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills.
  • Understanding of audience behaviour and market trends.
  • Strong organizational and project management abilities.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in agency environments.
  • Knowledge of SEO, paid advertising, and analytics tools.
  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • Familiarity with startup, innovation, or impact-driven sectors.

Why Join Studio 1947?

You'll have the freedom to experiment, test ideas, and shape marketing strategies that influence real outcomes. This role offers creative ownership, strategic involvement, and the opportunity to build brands that make a difference.

Ready to Apply?

Send us your CV, portfolio, campaign examples, case studies, or anything that demonstrates your ability to grow brands and engage audiences.
